title: ClientConfig public fields allow zero-body-size without constructor validation
description: ClientConfig is #[non_exhaustive] with all public fields. The constructor (JmapClient::new) validates that each size field is >0 and request_timeout >0. However, because the fields are pub, a caller can construct a valid JmapClient, then clone it and mutate config fields to zero (e.g. config.max_call_body = 0) on the clone. The clone path bypasses all validation. The invariant 'all size fields >0' is enforced at construction but not maintained across clone. Additionally, request_timeout can be set to Duration::ZERO on a cloned config. A caller who does this will hit a panic or silent failure at the next call(). Fix: make fields pub(crate) and expose builder methods, or validate at use-site rather than only at construction.
